# Season Shelf 1.2.10

- Added Recent series inside Change series, above the channel browser. Return to one of your last 12 successfully delivered series and choose another season without copying links from Telegram.
- Recent entries show the last requested season and quality, persist across restarts, and remain separate for each Telegram account.
- Saved menus are checked against Telegram before reuse. Deleted, changed or expired menus offer a prefilled fresh search; a group search is posted only when you submit it.
- Clear app data also clears recent series while keeping downloaded files.

Last requested does not mean downloaded. Bot menus and delivery messages are controlled by Telegram bots and may expire. The flow has automated coverage; live Telegram acceptance remains unverified.

Windows installations can update inside the app after this release is published. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned.
